_meta.title: Required Features — closed set of deterministic computations the compiled Strategy DSL may call
_meta.rule: Every feature maps 1:1 onto a primitive in strategy_reearcher/catalog/primitives.json. No feature introduces a concept, indicator or threshold that is not already in that primitive. Features whose primitive leaves a threshold unspecified declare it in 'frozen_params'; the implementation has no default and raises UnspecifiedParameter.
_meta.purity: f(visible_window, frozen_params) -> value. No mutable state, no wall clock, no randomness. The visible window is every bar on the requested timeframe whose close_time <= the decision bar's close_time (ADV-M18-R04).
_meta.implementation: strategy_compiler/engine/features.py, delegating to strategy_reearcher/engine/ict_primitives.py wherever that reference implementation already covers the operation.
_meta.notation: tf arguments are timeframe ROLES resolved through the strategy's 'timeframes' map.

features.returns: list of confirmed short-term swing highs or lows, oldest first
features.definition: Three-candle test: high[i] > high[i-1] and high[i] > high[i+1] (mirror for lows). Confirmed at i+1; a swing whose confirming candle has not closed is not returned.
An ITH is a short-term high with lower short-term highs on both sides; ITL is the mirror.
Bullish requires two consecutive higher highs AND two consecutive higher lows on the selected swing tier; bearish is the mirror; otherwise range.
Bullish structure -> most recent confirmed higher low. Bearish structure -> most recent confirmed lower high. Range -> None.

All four criteria: (1) range >= multiple x mean range of the previous lookback candles; (2) body/range >= ratio; (3) close beyond the prior candle's opposing extreme (no significant overlap); (4) breaks the supplied structural level. Criterion 4 is skipped only when broke_level is None, which the compiler never emits for a model that requires structure to break.

features.signature: displacement_leg(tf, at_index, direction) -> {origin, termination, origin_index, termination_index} | None
features.definition: The contiguous run of same-direction candles containing the displacement candle. Origin = the run's opposing extreme (low for a bullish leg), termination = the run's extreme in the direction of travel, both as of the decision bar. Body-vs-wick price selection follows the frozen fib_anchor so the leg and its Fibonacci are anchored consistently (INT-M07-R01 'only consistency is required').

features.signature: fvg(tf, direction, since_index) -> [{low, high, ce, index, direction}]
features.definition: Three consecutive candles, middle candle a displacement candle; bullish when low(c3) > high(c1) with zone [high(c1), low(c3)]; bearish when high(c3) < low(c1) with zone [high(c3), low(c1)]. Touching or overlapping wicks -> no gap. CE = zone midpoint. Labelled at the close of candle 3.
Failed = a candle body closes through the far side of the zone. The 'decisive' qualifier is unspecified in the source and is supplied by the frozen decisive_close_definition; there is no default.

A failed FVG that has since been retested from the opposite side and held. 'Held' has no computational test in the source; the frozen inversion_hold_definition supplies one and the item is registered as unsupported until it is supplied.

features.signature: order_block(tf, displacement_index, direction) -> {low, high, index, direction} | None
features.definition: Last opposing-close candle immediately before the displacement leg; zone = that candle's full high-low range.

test='body_close': a candle body closes through the far boundary -> breaker with inverted polarity. test='sweep_plus_mss': body close through the far boundary AND a preceding sweep AND a following MSS opposite the order block's original bias. Both operationalisations are documented (CF-09); the test is a frozen choice.
Intersection of two price zones; used for OB-FVG and array-OTE confluence.

features.signature: liquidity_pools(tf, side, kinds) -> [{price, kind, index, swept}]
features.definition: Buy-side pools above swing highs, equal highs, session highs and previous day/week/month highs; sell-side is the mirror. 'kinds' selects which of those the strategy marked. Pools are returned with their swept flag as of the decision bar.

features.signature: sweep(tf, level, side, since_index) -> {side, level, extreme, sweep_index, reversal_index, classification} | None
features.definition: Price trades at least sweep_min_penetration beyond the pool, then closes back through the level within sweep_reclaim_bars -> 'raid'; no reclaim within the window -> 'continuation'; window not yet elapsed -> 'pending'.

features.signature: level_reclaimed(tf, level, side, from_index, within_bars) -> bool
features.definition: The Judas reclaim test. The price test itself ('close back beyond' vs 'wick back beyond' vs 'close beyond plus buffer') is undefined in the source and is a frozen choice; no default exists.
Market is in a defined structure; a candle body closes beyond the governing structural point against that structure; the breaking move is displacement. Wick-only breaches never qualify.
External when the broken swing is a dealing-range boundary or a long-term pivot; internal otherwise.
Most recent pair of significant swing high and swing low framing current price action on the requested timeframe; equilibrium = (high + low) / 2.
Above equilibrium = premium, below = discount.
0 at the range low, 1 at the range high. The deep zone is roughly the outer 20-25% of the range.

features.signature: fib_levels(origin, termination) -> {eq, ote_start, ote_sweet, ote_end, ext_27, ext_62}
features.definition: 100% at leg origin, 0% at leg termination; OTE band and negative extensions at the frozen level constants.
Price lies between the OTE start and end levels, inclusive.
Shallow <= 50%, standard 62-79%, deep > 79%.
The decision bar's close time, converted to New York local time, falls inside the frozen window (start inclusive, end exclusive; wraps midnight). DST is handled by the zone conversion.
High and low of the completed session window. Returns None while the window is still open, so no decision can consume a range that is not yet final.
Opening price of the current daily, weekly or monthly period, known at period start.
Price above both the monthly and weekly open -> bullish; below both -> bearish; disagreement -> unclear.

Swing sequence and any MSS on the requested higher timeframe, plus dealing-range location, the named draw on liquidity and an explicit invalidation level. Direction is 'unclear' when the structure is a range.

method='three_factor': daily structure, price versus the day's (or prior day's) open, and the nearest significant unswept pool must agree, else neutral. method='single_mss': the most recent daily MSS sets the direction. Only closed daily candles and the already-printed daily open are used.

features.signature: dol(direction, scope) -> {price, kind, tf, irl_or_erl} | None
features.definition: Highest-priority unswept pool on the bias side: higher timeframe over lower, relative equals over single swings, untested over already raided, narrative-aligned over counter-narrative. scope='irl' restricts to pools inside the controlling range, 'erl' to pools beyond it.

Accumulation while inside the marked accumulation range; manipulation once a boundary is swept and reversal signs print; distribution once displacement plus MSS in the opposite direction confirm; failed on sweep-and-go, both sides swept with a doji/inside close, or opposing higher-timeframe force before the draw on liquidity is reached.
Two correlated instruments test the same extreme; one makes a new extreme and the other does not. Requires a second instrument feed and a frozen correlation-stability test and comparison window.
(equity x risk_fraction) / (|entry - stop| x value per unit price move).
Outcome in R units. Recorded always; used as a filter only where a strategy's frozen configuration selects the intermediate-level R:R minimum arm (CF-06).
Conjunction of the strategy's own eligibility items, each of which is itself a compiled node. Any failing item blocks entry. This feature adds no item of its own.
